keywords_en: ACDC #172 sets the Hegotá headliner deadline at February 4
EIP-7773 lists EIP-7997 as CFI per ACDE #227
Vitalik says more bandwidth is safer than less latency
summary_en: ERC-4337 moved to Review, ERC-7674 did too the same day, and a Bound Signatures ERC merged. ACDC #172 set the Hegotá headliner deadline at February 4, requiring a Magicians post and an ACD presentation. nixorokish updated EIP-7773 per ACDE #227: EIP-7997, the deterministic factory predeploy, is CFI, and EIP-8058, 7668 and 7745 are declined.
